text:
alex.m: Heads up — vendor (NordicShip) flagged a customs hold on the EU H100 partial shipment. They say customs wants HS reclassification + final commercial invoice to release. Holding ~12 H100s across two AWBs. This could impact the prod GPU pool tomorrow. Any quick options?

maya.k: ugh. which AWBs? ETA if we do reclass? can we get temp loaners?

logistics-sam: AWBs: AWB123456789, AWB987654321. Vendor says customs wants HSN 8471.80 + value breakdown. Reclass adds 24–48h + inspection risk. Vendor provided an air-expedite quote: +$9.8k, ETA 18–24h after pickup.

procurement-bot: Procurement approval needed for any expedite > $5k. @maya.k can you greenlight up to $10k if ops confirms cluster impact?

maya.k: we need capacity. Approving up to $10k for expedite if ops confirms it's critical.

ops-bot: prod-gpu-pool alerts: 3 nodes degraded, estimated capacity shortfall ~10 H100-equivalent slots. User-facing latency increase observed for two services. Recommend loaner pool for next 48h to avoid customer impact.

warehouse-eu: We have 6 loaner H100s in FRA staging that can ship same-day via FedEx IE. They still need AWB + customs docs from vendor (CI/CO). Can pack in 2 pallets, ready in ~3h once we have paperwork.

logistics-sam: Alternate forwarder quote (SkyBridge): door-to-door 12–16h, cost $6.2k. They still need vendor CI/CO with HSN. Vendor says reissuing docs will be slow, but vendor can dispatch loaners separately if we provide a return PO.

alex.m: can vendor ship loaners separately while customs sorts originals? ask for a split AWB and LOANER invoice (temporary loan).

vendor-nordic: we can create a separate loaner AWB, but note billing/legal: loaners must be marked "temporary loan — return required" on CI. We can dispatch loaners in ~6–8h once we receive a return PO from Redwood. We will include HSN 8471.80 on the paperwork.

maya.k: OK send the return PO template to vendor now. @procurement-bot pursue partial credit request with finance for customs delay cost.

procurement-bot: sending PO template: https://docs.internal/po-template (internal link). Creating approval ticket for SkyBridge expedite if needed.

alex.m: also need RMA labels for units vendor expects to be returned. warehouse-eu, can you prep labels + a simple serial checklist? suggested format: `SERIAL, MODEL, AWB`

warehouse-eu: will prep labels and staging sheet. Quick note: 2 serials show elevated thermal cycles in last 30 days — ops wants a quick QA burn on loaners before they go into pool.

ops-bot: QA checklist for loaners: run burn-in 15m, check idle temps, flash firmware to 1.2.3, verify NVLINK presence. If thermal fail, swap before shipping. I'll coordinate bench and signoff.

alex.m: Summarize action items: (1) vendor create loaner AWB + CI with HSN + return PO — vendor-nordic confirm by EOD; (2) warehouse prepare labels + QA flow; (3) procurement approve SkyBridge $6.2k if vendor cannot reissue CO quickly; (4) ops prepare canary routing to dedicated pool and monitor. :thumbsup:

vendor-nordic: Confirmed — starting loaner AWB, tentative LOAN AWB: LOAN123456, pickup window 6–8h. Will attach CI/CO and return PO once we receive the PO.

maya.k: approved SkyBridge up to $6.5k if needed.

procurement-bot: approval ticket created: PR-4521. Noting requested partial credit for delay; will follow up with finance.

alex.m: thanks everyone — I'll follow up in 2h with status.
